rationale: The new SEN-D1 sensor was not paired (bound_in_base and bound_in_app both false) while the base station had ample capacity (5/16 used) and supported the sensor's v2 protocol. The standard fix—factory reset of the sensor followed by re-pairing within 1 metre of the base station—resolved the issue on the next attempt, confirming a transient pairing failure rather than a capacity, protocol, or hardware fault.
